Treatments

Laser and injectable work, as landing pages should show it

Two distinct starting points — laser and skin resurfacing, and doctor-led injectables — each with its own consultation, rather than one generic appointment form.

Laser & skin resurfacing

Laser hair removal, laser resurfacing including erbium, skin needling and microdermabrasion — doctor-led, with a skin assessment before any course is recommended.

  • Laser hair removal
  • Laser resurfacing, including erbium
  • Skin needling
  • Microdermabrasion
  • Facials

Doctor-led injectables

Anti-wrinkle treatments and fillers, planned and performed by specialist cosmetic doctors at the Hawthorn clinic.

  • Anti-wrinkle treatments
  • Dermal fillers

Treatment prices are not published — ask at booking and your doctor will confirm the plan and cost at consultation.

How it works

Your visit, step by step

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Are treatments doctor-led?

Yes. Kiora Hawthorn describes its work as doctor-led non-surgical aesthetic medicine, with specialist cosmetic doctors including Dr Grace Lin and Dr Neville Lee See.

Do you publish treatment prices?

No treatment prices are published on this page. Your doctor confirms the plan and cost at consultation — use the booking form to ask.

What massage do you offer?

Maintenance 30-minute, full body, deep tissue, pregnancy, lymphatic 75-minute and hot stone massage.

Where are you, and when are you open?

723 Glenferrie Road, Hawthorn VIC 3122. Monday to Wednesday 9:00am–5:00pm, Thursday 9:00am–8:00pm, Friday 9:00am–6:00pm, Saturday 9:00am–5:00pm, Sunday closed.
